newsitem.title: USA: LSI Logic names Norby as CFO.
newsitem.headline: LSI Logic names Norby as CFO.

text.p: LSI Logic Corp said it named R. Douglas Norby as executive vice president and chief financial officer, effective November 30.
Since 1993, Norby has been senior vice president and chief financial officer for Mentor Graphics Corp of Oregon. He has been on LSI's board of directors for four years.
Prior to joining Mentor, Norby, 61, was the president and chief operating officer for Lucasfilm Ltd, a private entertainment company from 1985-92.
Mentor said it will immediately initiate an internal and external search for Norby's replacement.
LSI said that Norby replaces Albert Pimentel as chief financial officer.
Pimental resigned from LSI effective this Friday, to join Web TV as CFO.
Norby will shuttle between Mentor Graphics and LSI until his resignation from Mentor becomes effective, a spokesman for LSI said.
